build_context.profile: release, optimized; no workspace release-profile overrides
build_context.record_scope: Retained build logs establish successful release compilation; current source manifests establish defaults. Full original shell command/environment is not embedded in those logs.

host_context.basis: Session-recorded measurement host; independent read-only observation after acquisition, not an at-run host seal

native_family_fingerprint: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no whitespace, unescaped Unicode: sort records by their canonical JSON; each record has full_atoms, shown_atoms, shown_terms sorted by canonical JSON, plus costs. Resolve cumulative schema-2 atom catalogs before sorting. Omit record numbers; preserve all duplicate occurrences. Fingerprints here cover each qualification run, not every raw capture.
normalization: Authored source paths are repository-relative; filesystem device/inode numbers and capture paths are omitted. Content hashes, workload identities, measurements and RSS helper/child identities remain as recorded.
projection: All cases and timed wall/stage samples; all separate RSS receipts; per-phase medians; reported pass counts and source seals. Raw stdout/stderr and machine-local paths are omitted. Original report hashes identify retained private captures, not public downloads. This projection is not a zetesis-bench report input.
projection_encoding: Cell-level selected_models/cost are equal across both native and both reference populations; cell execution/grounding_mode/outcome and qualification-family fingerprint are shared by both native populations. support_work scalars mean the same count in every timed round; arrays retain varying counts. phase_median_ns omits unavailable phases, which are not zero. Other timed arrays retain all five rounds. Wall minimum, median and maximum are derived directly from wall_ns and shown in the complete Markdown tables.
scope: Frozen CPU support-publication change only; no later solve-output UX, statistics-free, scaling, Metal, overall speedup or memory-saving claim.
source_revision_basis: Retained source revision record and candidate revision receipt; commits are not embedded in the executable version string. Candidate commit parent is baseline.
